clips.title: The story
paras: Maggran Earthbinder is a grizzled tauren veteran appointed by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof to lead the Horde encampment at Sun Rock Retreat. Hardened by a lifetime of brutal conflict, he oversees the defense of the craggy valleys of Stonetalon against ravenous beasts and aggressive harpy covens. Though wearied by countless battles, he remains a steadfast guardian of the settlement.

Maggran Earthbinder was sent into the Stonetalon Mountains by High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof himself. A veteran of countless skirmishes and bloody campaigns, Maggran admits that age and violence have hardened his heart, stripping away the natural gentleness typical of his people. Sun Rock Retreat was meant to be both an outpost under his steady command and a place of respite, where warm winds and mountain sunshine might soothe his battle-worn spirit.
